interpretation: Analysis-ID gate preserves the immutable pre-disposition reliability D and coverage ERROR. While this exact candidate remained current and Automatic Analysis was disabled, the five individually evidenced FALSE-POSITIVE transitions recomputed the current candidate reliability/security/maintainability ratings to A. The post-disposition current gate remains ERROR solely for missing coverage. No overall green Sonar gate is claimed.

coverage_disposition.meaning: No genuine coverage artifact was imported by the standalone scanner; this is missing measurement, not a claim that targeted tests covered no code.
coverage_disposition.user_decision: Explicit local-milestone deferral; production release proof still required. No quality threshold or global setting was changed.

false_positive_dispositions.evidence: Intentional required-null authority contract: LifecycleCommand.target must be explicitly present, including explicit null when there is no saved target. Defaulting omission would weaken operator approval context. Existing regression absent_target_approval_requires_explicit_null_context rejects omission and accepts explicit null; lifecycle_requires_explicit_exact_context_and_refuses_posted_actor and deletion_cannot_be_approved_without_a_saved_target_and_version preserve exact authority. Source crates/domain/src/outbound_scim/lifecycle.rs. Reviewed against clean candidate97ac and documented in833f16a3. False positive; no suppression or scope exclusion.

Intentional required-null authority contract: LifecycleCommand.etag must be explicitly present, including explicit null when no target exists. Existing absent_target_approval_requires_explicit_null_context rejects omission; exact saved target/version is required for deletion. Defaulting omission weakens this verified fail-closed contract. Source crates/domain/src/outbound_scim/lifecycle.rs; inline rationale833f16a3. False positive; no suppression or scope exclusion.

Credential-like static assertion literal entirely in #[cfg(test)] module, test the_ping_authorization_is_the_notification_token_as_a_bearer in crates/oidc/src/ciba.rs. It verifies CIBA header formatting using a locally hardcoded test UUID; it is not issued to a real identity/service or loaded from an operator credential. Production build excludes the test module. False positive after direct source inspection; no real credential removed or rotated, no source scope exclusion.

Static notification-token assertion literal entirely in #[cfg(test)] module, test a_decision_is_posted_as_the_specification_says in crates/server/src/outbox/ciba.rs. The harness constructs its own synthetic event and notification token for request assertions; no real upstream credential or deployed identity exists. Production excludes the test module. False positive after direct source inspection; no scope exclusion or blanket secrets waiver.

Synthetic PostgreSQL password literal entirely in #[cfg(test)] module, test debugging_the_configuration_does_not_leak_the_database_password in crates/server/src/config.rs. The test builds local TOML/config data solely to assert Debug omits its fake password; it does not connect to a real database or read a deployment credential. Production excludes the test module. False positive after direct source inspection; no real password rotation or scope exclusion.
